tirex_alias_path.description: The URL path alias for the tirex example map.

tirex_document_root.description: The document root directory for the tirex example map.

apache_listen_port.description: The port on which the Apache virtual host listens.

mod_tile_tile_dir.description: The directory where mod_tile stores tiles.

tileset_url_path.description: The URL path relative to the virtual host under which the tile set is served.

tileset_name.description: The name of the tile set, used in communication with tirex.

mod_tile_enable_stats.description: Enable or disable tile delivery stats.

mod_tile_bulk_mode.description: Turns on bulk mode for mod_tile.

mod_tile_request_timeout.description: Timeout before giving up for a tile to be rendered.

mod_tile_missing_request_timeout.description: Timeout before giving up for a tile to be rendered that is otherwise missing.

mod_tile_max_load_old.description: Load threshold above which old tiles are not re-rendered.

mod_tile_max_load_missing.description: Load threshold above which missing tiles are not rendered.

mod_tile_renderd_socket_name.description: Socket path to connect to the rendering daemon.

mod_tile_cache_duration_max.description: Upper bound on cache duration for tiles in seconds.

mod_tile_cache_duration_dirty.description: Cache duration for dirty/outdated tiles in seconds.

mod_tile_cache_duration_minimum.description: Minimum cache duration for fresh tiles in seconds.

mod_tile_cache_duration_medium_zoom_leve.description: Zoom level below which medium caching applies.

mod_tile_cache_duration_medium_time.description: Cache duration in seconds for medium zoom level tiles.

mod_tile_cache_duration_low_zoom_level.description: Zoom level below which low caching applies.

mod_tile_cache_duration_low_time.description: Cache duration in seconds for low zoom level tiles.

mod_tile_cache_last_modified_factor.description: Factor for determining cache duration based on last modified time.

mod_tile_enable_tile_throttling_xforward.description: Use X-Forwarded-For header for throttling (0=client IP, 1=X-Forwarded-For first).

mod_tile_throttling_tiles_pool.description: Pool size in tiles for tile serving throttling.

mod_tile_throttling_tiles_rate.description: Topup rate in tiles per second for tile serving throttling.

mod_tile_throttling_renders_pool.description: Pool size in tiles for render request throttling.

mod_tile_throttling_renders_rate.description: Topup rate in tiles per second for render request throttling.
